en.title: Turok: Origins Revives the Dino Hunter for a New Generation This Fall
en.summary: The iconic dinosaur-slaying franchise is making a comeback with Turok: Origins, promising a return to the arcade-style shooter action that defined its early years. Saber Interactive takes the helm, aiming to bring the beloved series back into the spotlight.
en.body:
The roar of a Tyrannosaurus Rex is about to echo through gaming consoles once again. **Turok: Origins**, the latest entry in the legendary dinosaur-hunting franchise, is set to launch in Fall 2026, bringing the beloved IP back from a long hiatus. Developed by **Saber Interactive**, known for their work on titles like *Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2*, this new installment aims to recapture the visceral thrill that made **Turok: Dinosaur Hunter** a staple on the Nintendo 64.

For many millennials, the original **Turok** games on the N64 were formative experiences, offering a unique blend of first-person shooting and prehistoric survival. After a string of releases that struggled to maintain relevance, the series seemed to fade into obscurity, with its last major outing in 2008. Now, **Saber Interactive** is resurrecting the franchise, and early impressions from Summer Game Fest 2026 suggest a faithful, yet modernized, return.

## A Familiar Hunt, Modernized

**Turok: Origins** is shaping up to be a linear, mission-driven shooter, a design choice that harks back to the straightforward, action-packed gameplay of its predecessors. Players can expect to face off against hordes of prehistoric beasts and potentially other adversaries in arena-like encounters, blasting and slicing their way through digitized viscera. The game will feature both first and third-person perspectives, offering flexibility for different playstyles. Adding a strategic layer, players can choose from three distinct character classes before each mission: the acrobatic Raven, the balanced Cougar, and the formidable, tank-like Bison. These classes come with unique loadouts and special abilities designed to support squad-based play, which can be enjoyed solo or with up to three teammates. This focus on immediate, satisfying combat is precisely what made the original **Turok** games so addictive.

## What Fans Can Expect

The return of **Turok** is undoubtedly a cause for celebration among fans who grew up with the franchise. The promise of classic arcade-style shooter action, combined with modern co-op features and class-based gameplay, suggests that **Saber Interactive** understands what made **Turok** special. The potential for this revival to recapture the magic of the N64 era is high, especially given the developer's track record with action-heavy titles. The game is slated for release on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Nintendo's upcoming Switch 2, ensuring broad accessibility for a wide range of players eager to once again wield the iconic bow and arrow against formidable foes.

## What's Next

**Turok: Origins** is scheduled to launch in Fall 2026 across multiple platforms. Further details regarding specific release dates and additional gameplay features are expected to be announced closer to the launch window.

tr.title: Turok: Origins Bu Sonbahar Yeni Bir Nesle Dino Avcısını Canlandırıyor
tr.summary: İkonik dinozor avcısı franchise, Turok: Origins ile geri dönüyor ve erken yıllarını tanımlayan arcade-stil shooter aksiyonuna dönüş vaat ediyor. Saber Interactive, sevgili seriyi yeniden öne çıkarmayı hedefliyor. Turok: Origins, Fall 2026'da birçok platformda piyasaya sürülecek.
tr.body:
Tyrannosaurus Rex'in kükremesi, oyun konsollarında tekrar yankılanmaya hazır. **Turok: Origins**, efsanevi dinozor avcısı franchise'ın son girişi, uzun bir aradan sonra sevgili IP'yi geri getirmek üzere Fall 2026'da piyasaya sürülecek. **Saber Interactive** tarafından geliştirilen bu yeni bölüm, **Turok: Dinosaur Hunter**'ın Nintendo 64'te bir standart haline getirdiği içgüdüsel heyecanı yeniden yakalamayı amaçlıyor.

Çok sayıda milenyum çocuğu için, N64'teki orijinal **Turok** oyunları, ilk şahıs nişancılık ve prehistorik hayatta kalma arasında benzersiz bir karışım sunan formatif deneyimlerdi. İlgisini sürdürmekte zorlanan bir dizi sürümün ardından, seri görünüşte gözden kayboldu, son büyük çıkışı 2008'de gerçekleşti. Şimdi, **Saber Interactive** franchise'ı canlandırıyor ve 2026 Yaz Oyun Festivali'nden alınan ilk izlenimler, sadık ancak modernleştirilmiş bir dönüşü öneriyor.

## Tanıdık Bir Av, Modernize Edilmiş

**Turok: Origins**, doğrusal, görev odaklı bir nişancı olarak şekilleniyor, bu tasarım seçimi doğrudan, aksiyon dolu oyun oynama deneyimine geri dönüyor. Oyuncular, prehistorik canavarlar ve potansiyel olarak diğer düşmanlarla karşılaşmaya, arenamsı karşılaşmalarda dijital iç organları yok etmeye hazırlanıyor. Oyun, hem ilk şahıs hem de üçüncü şahıs perspektiflerini sunacak, farklı oyun stilleri için esneklik sağlayacak. Stratejik bir katman ekleyerek, oyuncular her görevden önce üç ayrı karakter sınıfından seçim yapabilecek: akrobatik Raven, dengeli Cougar ve tank gibi Bison. Bu sınıflar, takım tabanlı oyunu desteklemek üzere tasarlanmış benzersiz yüklemeleri ve özel yetenekleri içeriyor, bu da solo veya en fazla üç takım arkadaşıyla keyif alınabilecek bir deneyim sunuyor. Bu, doğrudan, tatmin edici savaşa odaklanma, orijinal **Turok** oyunlarını bu kadar bağımlılık yapıcı kılan şeyin tam olarak ta kendisi.

## Hayranlar Neye Beklemeli

**Turok**'un dönüşü, franchise ile büyüyen hayranlar arasında şüphesiz bir sevinç nedeni. Klasik arcade-stil shooter aksiyonu, modern işbirliği özellikleri ve sınıf tabanlı oyun oynama ile birleştirme vaadi, **Saber Interactive**'in **Turok**'u özel kılan şeyleri anladığını gösteriyor. N64 döneminin büyüsünü yeniden yakalama potansiyeli yüksek, özellikle geliştiricinin aksiyon dolu başlıklarla ilgili geçmişine bakıldığında. Oyun, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, PC ve Nintendo'nun yaklaşan Switch 2'si için piyasaya sürülecek, böylece geniş bir oyuncu kitlesine, novamente güçlü düşmanlarla karşı karşıya gelmek için ikonik yay ve ok'u kullanma fırsatı sunuyor.

## Sonraki Adımlar

**Turok: Origins**, Fall 2026'da birçok platformda piyasaya sürülecek. Belirli.release tarihleri ve ek oyun özellikleri hakkında daha ayrıntılı bilgiler, lansman penceresine yaklaşırken açıklanması bekleniyor.

content_raw: Any millennial who had a Nintendo 64 will tell you that one of the staples for the console was Turok, a franchise which began with 1997’s Turok: Dinosaur Hunter and released four games on the N64 alone. Since then, the first-person shooter title has struggled to maintain its relevance and audience over subsequent gaming generations, seemingly coming to an end with 2008’s Turok , published by Disney Interactive Studios of all companies. Saber Interactive has now taken the reins on the series with the upcoming Turok: Origins , which we got to play at Summer Game Fest 2026 as part of their demos available on-site, including Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival . Playable solo or in a team of up to three people, Turok: Origins unfolds like a linear mission-driven shooter in the tradition of Saber’s recent Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 albeit with its sci-fi/prehistoric aesthetic mash-up still very much intact. Players have an option between three character classes to choose from between deployments, each with their own loadouts and special abilities to support the squad. We personally went with the more acrobatic Raven class and the middle of the road Cougar class, though we were intrigued by the hard-hitting, tank-like Bison class and teamed up with several Bison players in our run. Once deployed, Turok: Origins feels right within the arcade-style wheelhouse that made its original titles so much fun. There is no question of where to go next, no set of complex mission objectives, at least not in the build that we played. It’s simply a matter of progressing to the next enemy encounter, usually in an arena-like portion of the level, and blasting and/or cutting down every enemy in the immediate area into digitized viscera. And, naturally, this straightforward approach is where the entire game excels. All of the weapons that we tried felt intuitive and distinct from one another, be it futuristic assault rifles to chugging shotguns with plenty of up-close stopping power. The action is as frenetically paced as you can imagine, but we never got lost in the chaos, being able to tell where the enemies were coming from and keep track of where the ammo and health restoratives were around a given level. And every class has their own glory kill animations for each major enemy type in the game when the target’s health is low enough, denoted by a glowing outline, which had us rushing in to finish off each vulnerable opponent in gruesomely satisfying ways. And did I personally get the glory kill on the final boss of this demo build? I sure did and, yes, it felt fantastic . The game also looks much more visually impressive than I anticipated, rather than the repetitive environments and assets that tend to get used in a lot of contemporary extraction shooters. While not the most eye-popping game that we played during SGF 2026 weekend, Turok: Origins also isn’t necessarily trying to go for the most detailed and hardware-pushing presentation.
